line.name: Montecristo Nicaragua Series
line.description: Not on the site. 100% Nicaraguan, made by A.J. Fernandez in Esteli. FLAG: may overlap with or be related to a separately-named 'Montecristo 1935 Anniversary Nicaragua' line referenced in some sources with different vitola names (Demi, No.2/Belicoso) - the relationship between the two names was not clarified in research. Treating as a separate line per its own distinct name and vitola set until clarified.
